metadata.case_name: WONG MAN NGAI v. MULTI-BEST MANUFACTURES LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_after: office boy/odd-job worker at a private primary school

injuries.description: crushing injuries to his left hand
source: suffered crushing injuries to his left hand from the moulding machine he was operating at the time.
Dr. David Lee in his report dated 25th June 1987 (Document 10) has described the limitation of movement in the four fingers of the Plaintiff's left hand which is not his preferred hand.
Dr. Lee reports that the left hand is markedly deformed with only 50% of function remaining in the left four fingers.

The Plaintiff received 3 operations to the fingers of his left hand on 13th June 1981, 15th April 1982 and 24th June 1982 at the Princess Margaret Hospital and also long periods of physiotherapy in the hand clinic.

manifestations.description: limitation of movement in the four fingers of the Plaintiff's left hand
only 50% of function remaining in the left four fingers
still feels pain in his left hand on occasions while working as a packager or whenever the weather changes
Prior to the accident the Plaintiff played basket-ball which he cannot participate in now
he is unable to drive a motor vehicle because of the injury to his left hand

treatments_received: surgical operations to fingers of left hand (3 operations)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Prior to the accident the Plaintiff played basket-ball which he cannot participate in now
